reply.text: Beta alanine is a supplement, and I don't give amounts for supplements, so I can't tell you how much to take. What I can say in general terms is that it's the one people usually take for training that runs a few minutes at a hard effort, like repeat sets or a conditioning finisher, and its effects take weeks to build rather than showing up in a single session. For the dose itself, check with a doctor or dietitian who knows your health history. If you tell me what your sessions look like, I can tell you whether the work you're doing is the kind a supplement would even matter for.
